objects.name: Analytic 2141
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an ICS Linux network-facing service spawning a shell, interpreter, or other child process outside the expected service-child baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=execve; shell/interpreter process is spawned by an ICS network-facing service or other unexpected parent process
